high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "index.daily," located in Delhi, India. The post is part of a series, as indicated by the number "05" at the top left corner, suggesting it is the fifth post in a sequence. The content of the post discusses the deregulation of petrol and diesel prices in India. It explains that before the deregulation in 2010 for petrol and 2014 for diesel, Indian oil companies were selling these fuels at a subsidized rate. To compensate for the lost revenue due to the subsidies, the Indian government issued Oil bonds to oil companies
